title: Revisiting Non-Acyclic GFlowNets in Discrete Environments
venue: ICML 2025 (Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 267)
one_line_en: Rebuilds non-acyclic GFlowNet theory on finite graphs with the backward policy as primitive: flows are expected visit counts, positive conservative flows biject with (P_B, F(s_f)), fixed P_B gives a unique solution so loss stability is irrelevant, and minimal expected length equals minimal total flow (a linear objective over the flow polytope); also generalizes the entropy-regularized RL equivalence.
one_line_zh: 在有限图上以反向策略为第一性对象重建非无环 GFlowNet 理论：流 = 期望访问次数，正守恒流与 (P_B, F(s_f)) 一一对应，固定 P_B 时解唯一、稳定性无关，最小期望长度等价于最小总流（流多面体上的线性目标）；并把熵正则 RL 等价推广到有环情形。

sources: local PDF papers/2502.07735.pdf (arXiv v3, 2025-09-11); first-page footer: Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning, Vancouver, Canada. PMLR 267, 2025
